title: Dialogue. Constellation Software AGM and RH 1Q25 Update

reader_summary.headline: Welcome to the Synopsis, a Speedwell Research podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Welcome to the Synopsis, a Speedwell Research podcast. Today we have another installment in our dialogue series where Drew and I talk about whatever we feel like. And today we're going to be discussing the Constellation Annual General Meeting, which is once a year, we get to hear Mark Leonard expouse his wisdom.

key_points.text: We get him no more than one time a year.
key_points.evidence_quote: We get him no more than one time a year.

key_points.text: So we're always very grateful for when he spent some time and always has interesting updates.
key_points.evidence_quote: So we're always very grateful for when he spent some time and always has interesting updates.

key_points.text: And then we'll be doing a little brief RH update.
key_points.evidence_quote: And then we'll be doing a little brief RH update.

key_points.text: We just did one, but it just had earnings.
key_points.evidence_quote: We just did one, but it just had earnings.

thesis: The speakers discuss Constellation Software's AGM, noting that while organic revenue growth has improved to the low-to-mid single digits, CEO Mark Leonard attributes this to inflation rather than a strategic shift or lessons learned from the Topicus acquisition. Leonard reinforced the view that external acquisition opportunities are becoming less attractive due to competition, which makes internal capital deployment and existing businesses relatively more attractive compared to historical precedents.
